scope: Final source and256 validation review; tensor and transverse-force equations derived independently.
findings: For P=I+pi and velocity u(y) along x, affine transport and Lorentz rotation give pxx=2 B tau2 pxy, pyy=−pxx, and u_prime=−(1+4 B² tau2²)*pxy/tau2. Thus the even viscosity and longitudinal solve are correct.

Transverse momentum balance fixes the electrochemical field Ec_y=B*u+derivative_y(pyy), so the signed voltage is the Lorentz integral plus the normal-stress difference at the two probes. This remains valid for variable B; the implementation includes its variation inside the endpoint stress.

The measured field excludes the arbitrary isotropic thermodynamic pressure gradient; this definition resolves the pressure/electric-field ambiguity. The public closed moment model and no-slip boundaries avoid an unstated kinetic wall closure.

The oracle finite-difference velocity solve and independent momentum-flux BVP use different spatial formulations. The reference uses an interpolant derivative in its tensor residual, so its1e-8 internal check appropriately exceeds the1e-9 solve tolerance; grading thresholds are unchanged.
